reading: A house theorem may rest on Quot.sound alone; any other axiom (propext, Classical.choice, or sorryAx) is a violation. sorryAx violations are additionally fatal: an admitted proof fails the gate outright, regardless of the ratchet baseline. The baseline is a ratchet, not a target — --ratchet only ever lowers it toward the current violation count, --init only ever creates it when absent, and the gate fails whenever current violations exceed the recorded baseline.
